article_title: How switching your bank account could earn you up to £220

tasks.prompt: What is the main message of the article?
options: Changing current accounts can bring a cash reward, but customers should check the conditions and wider banking features
Every UK bank now pays all customers £220 automatically
Keeping the same bank always produces the best interest rate
Opening several accounts at once guarantees a better mortgage
tasks.correct_answer: Changing current accounts can bring a cash reward, but customers should check the conditions and wider banking features
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שמעבר חשבון עשוי לזכות את הלקוח במענק, אך חשוב לבדוק את תנאי המבצע ואת התאמת החשבון כולו.

tasks.prompt: What is the largest switching reward mentioned in the headline and article?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסכום המרבי שמופיע בכתבה הוא 220 ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: Why do rival banks offer switching incentives?
options: To stop customers from using direct debits
To make mortgage applications unnecessary
To overcome customers' loyalty or inertia and attract them from competitors
To prevent customers from reading old statements
tasks.correct_answer: To overcome customers' loyalty or inertia and attract them from competitors
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לקוחות רבים נשארים בבנק מתוך נאמנות או חוסר רצון לשנות, ולכן בנקים מתחרים מציעים תמריץ כספי כדי לעודד מעבר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “inertia” describe?
options: A bank's excellent reputation
A fee charged for an overdraft
A reward paid after a switch
The tendency to remain with the same bank without taking action
tasks.correct_answer: The tendency to remain with the same bank without taking action
tasks.explanation_hebrew: inertia בהקשר הכתבה היא הנטייה להישאר במצב הקיים ולא לעבור לבנק אחר.

tasks.prompt: What does the current-account switching service help move to the new account?
options: A customer's mortgage property
Regular payments such as direct debits and standing orders
The bank's branch staff
Old paper statements from every previous bank
tasks.correct_answer: Regular payments such as direct debits and standing orders
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שירות המעבר מפנה תשלומים קבועים, כגון הוראות קבע וחיובים ישירים, אל החשבון החדש.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean when it says repeated applications may “dent” a credit score?
options: They may guarantee a cash bonus
They may redirect every payment twice
They may cause a small negative effect on the score
They may erase a mortgage immediately
tasks.correct_answer: They may cause a small negative effect on the score
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפועל dent מתאר פגיעה קטנה; פתיחת חשבונות רבים ברצף עלולה להשפיע מעט לרעה על דירוג האשראי.

tasks.prompt: Name three things, apart from the cash bonus, that a customer should compare before switching banks.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה שיקולים מעשיים שהכתבה מציגה, ולא להסתפק בגובה המענק.
expected_points: Overdraft fees or terms
Customer service and the bank's reputation
Interest rates or other account benefits
Accessibility of branches, apps or statements
Whether the account suits future borrowing such as a mortgage

tasks.prompt: Summarise how a bank-account switch can produce a reward and what a customer must do before and after the move.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את התמריץ, תנאי הזכאות, שירות המעבר ובדיקות מעשיות לאחר המעבר.
expected_points: Banks offer cash incentives to attract customers from rivals
The customer must meet the specific offer conditions
The switching service redirects regular payments to the new account
The customer should compare fees, service and account features, not only the bonus
The customer should check recurring payments and keep any needed old statements

tasks.prompt: Why can doing nothing be profitable for a bank but costly for a long-term customer?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין נאמנות או אינרציה של הלקוח לבין חוסר תחרות על התנאים שהוא מקבל.
expected_points: A loyal or inactive customer is less likely to compare rivals
The bank can retain the customer without offering a switching bonus
The customer may miss better rates, lower fees or cash incentives
Small disadvantages can add up over many years
Regular comparison creates competitive pressure on banks

tasks.prompt: Using the article, write a short recommendation to someone considering a £220 switching offer. Include two benefits and two cautions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג שני יתרונות ושני סייגים המבוססים על הכתבה, ולסיים בהמלצה מנומקת.
expected_points: The cash reward can improve the customer's bank balance
The switch service can move regular payments automatically
The £220 reward depends on meeting the offer's conditions
Fees, overdraft terms, service and accessibility still matter
Several applications in quick succession may affect a credit score
Needed old statements and recurring payments should be checked
